messages:
maria.g: @channel Escalation from Acme — private VPC deployment. Customer reports audit logs missing for ~48h and our exporter getting `403` from their KMS during wrap calls. Sidecar marks objects as delivered but S3 keys absent. Need security + infra triage asap.

jordan_k: Can you paste the exact error and cluster? Also which NAT/gw are they on?

maria.g: From exporter.log: `kms:DecryptCiphertext failed: AccessDeniedException (403)` and repeated `tls: handshake failure` with remote `kms.acme.internal:443`. Cluster: acme-prod-vpc-17, nodepool private-3. First seen 2025-07-31T23:58Z. Support attached pcap and exporter tail.

priya: :eyes: Sounds like outbound firewall or NAT misroute. Do we have a proxy in the path? Please run `tcpdump` on the sidecar and paste the TLS ClientHello/Alert lines.

alex_s: I looked at the pcap snippet support provided — TLS alerts `handshake_failure` and ACK resets. Control-plane NAT shows `x-forwarded-for` rewriting to our NAT IP 35.189.45.6. Snippet: ```17:02:11.123456 IP 10.0.25.12.443 > 10.0.1.5.52314: Flags [P.], seq 1:517, ack 1, win 65535``` then TLS Alert `handshake_failure`.

sam_c: Customer said exporter retries then logs success (marks delivered) but S3 object missing. I can repro with their exporter config — sidecar ack before flush if async.

maria.g: Repro steps support used:
1. `kubectl exec -n redwood sidecar-xyz -- curl -v https://kms.acme.internal/wrap` -> returns 403
2. `kubectl exec -n redwood sidecar-xyz -- tcpdump -i eth0 port 443 -w /tmp/p.cap`
3. `tail -n100 /var/log/sidecar/exporter.log`

priya: Also flag: compliance check shows tenant audit retention mismatch. Customer policy requires 180d but tenant config shows 90d. That's a separate compliance escalation — need to confirm if change happened during recent migration.

jordan_k: Infra check: NAT gateway egress ACL had a deny rule that overlaps with the customer's internal KMS anycast range (10.1.0.0/24) due to stale aggregated deny from a previous tenant. That would cause selective misrouting to a blackhole async and TLS resets. Plan: remove deny rule and add explicit allow for 10.1.0.0/24. Patching now.

alex_s: Quick mitigation: push sidecar fallback to internal control-plane proxy by setting `AWS_KMS_ENDPOINT` to `http://10.200.5.12:8443` (internal) so we bypass the broken route. Canary at 1% deployed.

maria.g: Sam — after NAT fix can you validate S3 objects for 2025-07-30..2025-08-01 and confirm exporter no longer returns 403? Priya — we need audit log change confirmation.

sam_c: Running checks now, will post in ~15m.

audit-bot: Audit event recorded: `config.change` by `automation:migration` on `tenant:acme` at 2025-07-31T23:05Z — param `audit_retention_days` set to `90` (previous `180`).

priya: That automation change explains retention TTL discrepancy. We need RBAC hardening: automation should not be able to change `audit_retention_days` without approval. I'll open a policy PR and a retrospective.

jordan_k: NAT deny removed at 2025-08-01T02:35Z. Verified egress with `traceroute kms.acme.internal` — path now reaches 54.123.45.67:443, no drops.

sam_c: S3 recheck: objects for 2025-07-31 appear after re-queue. Exporter log shows successful wrap: `KMS wrap OK` and no further 403s. Repro used: `curl -sS -H 'Host: kms.acme.internal' https://10.200.5.12:8443/wrap` -> 200 OK.

maria.g: Great. Priya — please triage automation ownership and roll-forward policy. Also we need a short customer-facing summary and an RCA.

priya: Will create PR to deny automation write on `audit_retention_days`, add a runbook check for tenant migration scripts, and prepare compliance report.

maria.g: Action items recap:
- Infra: validate NAT rules removed and monitor for 2h (jordan_k)
- Support: confirm full backfill of missed audit objects and exporter health (sam_c)
- Product/Sec: RBAC policy change + compliance report (priya)
- Send customer update + timeline (maria.g)

maria.g: Draft customer update ready, will send after product confirms TTL revert. Thanks everyone :lock:
